Name: FS - SH's Gloves and Sleeves Pack
Author: plurffle
Description:
Just like my Cottagecore Set, this has been sitting untouched in my laptop since November 2022. It was almost done by then even, I just decided to take a break [i]again[/i].﻿ There isn't much in this pack as of now, but if I'll add more if I get more ideas. There are currently only 15 pieces for you to choose from (see images to know what are included in this FS pack), all recolorable.

[b]The sleeves and gloves work for both female and male farmer sprites (each accessory/sleeves have two versions each).[/b]

[img]https://imgur.com/OrH6e66.png[/img]
As of version 1.1, there are [u]9 in the Sleeves category[/u] and [u][u]6 in the Accessories category[/u][/u].

[img]https://imgur.com/bBYKTj4.png[/img]
